what: The sound on/off button is drawn as a one-cycle sine wave (height .25) with the phase flowing .1 per frame. When pressed, the amplitude shrinks by 10% of the remaining difference each frame down to 0, becoming a flat line and the flow stops, and pressing again brings the ripple back at the same rate. On hover, an ‹off/on› tag follows the cursor.

options.lerp: Rate approached per frame when switching on and off, default .1
options.[data-fx-part=wave]: Wave svg (required) — created if there is no path
options.[data-fx-part=tip]: Optional tag that follows the cursor — data-on and data-off hold the on and off text
options.fx:toggle: Fires with detail.on on each press — tie the sound volume to this
